plannedSlices.notes: Re-scoped active RMG work away from owner-H3M sample-by-sample exact-count fitting. Added docs/native-rmg-generalized-policy-regate-audit.md, which records exact counts as diagnostics only, identifies owner-specific runtime branches as temporary fixture/diagnostic debt, and defines the next implementation direction around generalized template/profile policy, zone graph semantics, town/guard/blocker route closure, road materialization, water/underground policy, and corpus subsystem grouping. Earlier local Small-islands count-fitting edits were abandoned before commit; uploaded/generated map evidence remains untracked. Owner-corpus report schema v6 now emits generalized_policy_failure_summary alongside raw exact deltas; after native rebuild, the raw mapped gate remained 8/9 while the active Small islands failure was grouped into guard_policy, town_policy, decoration_blocker_policy, object_density_policy, and object_reward_policy. Added runtime_policy_classification to native RMG output/report/provenance/metadata and updated the auto-template batch report to require it while guarding normal generated seeds against seed-specific owner overrides. Added explicit generated-map level selection using Surface Only (1 Level) and Surface + Underground (2 Levels), and corrected one-level scoped islands terrain so underground terrain appears only on requested two-level maps. Fixed the Small normal-water two-level owner-corpus package reflow so player start towns remain on their generated start anchors, then made native town placement level-aware so the owner Small normal-water two-level path preserves four surface towns plus one underground supplemental town. The owner corpus now improves to 7/9 mapped pass; remaining mapped failures are Small islands two-level and XL no-water. Added fast non-Godot RMG audit tooling so H3M/native package validation no longer depends on a full Godot startup; Godot remains for generation/adoption/editor/runtime integration only. Small islands two-level work also corrected level-aware object/guard/town pathing defects exposed by the focused diagnostic, while broad production parity remains in progress. Focused Small islands two-level validation now passes in a narrow Godot integration smoke; the slow full Godot owner-corpus parser loop is no longer the recommended tight validation path. Fast audit batch mode now parses the whole uploaded owner H3M corpus and local native AMAP evidence without Godot, providing a corpus-level baseline for the next generalized RMG policy fixes. Native batch export now isolates the single Godot-required generation step from Python-side corpus comparison; the resulting generated batch confirms broad object-density underfill on large two-level maps and sets the next generalized policy target. Generalized catalog-auto generation now fixes the first generated-batch rule failures with size/level-aware density floors, eligible underground decoration/scenic and road distribution, strict town-spacing/same-zone town guards, and targeted batch export; a full 18-case export passes the fast Python generated-rule gate with zero density gaps and zero native rule failures. A broader fast policy gate now fails that same batch with 14 guard/object/town/road/guard-reward policy gaps, keeping the active slice correctly in progress instead of accepting structural package validity as production readiness. Native catalog-auto scenic-object and guard floors reduce that policy gap count to 5 on combined 18-package evidence; the generated guard floor now also raises stale fixture caps for normal non-owner-discovered catalog-auto packages, the Small two-level road floor raises road density to 116 cells per targeted package, and the fast policy epsilon clears sub-tile road-density noise. Generated two-level neutral-town floors clear the remaining density/category policy gaps. The fast validator now adds a road-topology gate; generalized road component materialization now clears that gate on fresh 18-package evidence with 0 topology gaps. Normal generated Large/XL land seeds no longer activate owner-specific land profile overrides; the XL one-level road floor now keeps 144x144_l1 above the fast policy floor without that override. The object-category floor now raises normal catalog-auto scenic/other-object density before decorative filler, and the fast policy gate requires at least 60% of owner object-category density. The Godot auto-template report is retained as an integration smoke, but slow Godot parser/comparison reports are not part of the tight correctness loop. Full production parity remains in progress. Medium two-level islands category caps now exact-match broad owner counts while preserving route, road, and town deltas at zero; production_ready remains false because terrain/road-component and other profile gaps remain. Medium two-level normal-water route/terrain cleanup reduced focused production-gap severity to 96 and kept merged 18-case Python gates clean; production_ready remains false because guarded-route, road-component, town capacity, and other profile gaps remain. Medium two-level islands terrain cleanup reduced focused terrain-blocked delta to +3 and kept merged 18-case Python gates clean; production_ready remains false because road-component, guard-footprint, XL/Large terrain, and route-shape gaps remain.
